clue.text: Embed spy to guard European royal family

parts.note: to plant something is to embed it firmly

indicators.note: the spy word surrounds the European letter as a guard stands round what it protects

parts.note: an agent is a spy

explanation.surface: Planting an undercover spy close to a European monarchy to protect it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Plantagenets were the dynasty of English kings from Henry II to Richard III.

clue.text: Last of Israeli pounds deposited in banks of Lebanese city

indicators.note: the letters are put down between the two banks
the banks of a word are its outer letters, like a river's two banks

parts.note: first and last letters L and E

indicators.note: only the final letter of Israeli is wanted

parts.note: final letter I
LL, the plural of l for libra, means pounds

explanation.surface: An Israeli's last pounds are put into banks in a Lebanese city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lebanese city' looks like the definition but only 'city' is; Lebanese gives the outer letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Lille is a large city in northern France, near the Belgian border.

clue.text: Writer of volume on fine Highland town reels

indicators.note: to reel is to whirl back, so the combined letters turn around

parts.note: OK means fine, all right
Oban is a port town in the Scottish Highlands

explanation.surface: An author's book about a nice Scottish town where people dance reels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reels' suggests Scottish dances to suit Oban, but it is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Vladimir Nabokov was the Russian-American novelist who wrote Lolita and Pale Fire.

clue.text: Sharp expresses dissatisfaction about being detained in A&E

indicators.note: the turned letters are held between A and E

parts.note: the letters A and E taken from A&E, the hospital emergency department

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the tutting word reads backwards

parts.note: someone who tuts clicks the tongue in disapproval

explanation.surface: A shrewd patient complains about being kept in casualty.
explanation.walkthrough: A&E (accident and emergency) is the British hospital emergency department.
explanation.definitionFit: An astute person is shrewd and quick-witted, which is what sharp means of a mind.

clue.text: Upset setter — sounded like setter possibly got set to set sail

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the letters read in reverse

parts.note: the compiler of a crossword refers to themself as the setter, so setter gives me
a setter is also a gun dog, and a dog barks

explanation.surface: A distressed compiler made dog noises before heading off on a voyage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Setter' appears twice with two meanings: the crossword compiler, then the breed of dog.
explanation.definitionFit: To embark is to go aboard a ship, readying oneself to depart on a voyage.

clue.text: Turning up volume, wives undressed intending to stir passion

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a tome is a large book or volume

indicators.note: undressed means stripped of outer covering, so the first and last letters go

parts.note: middle letters IVE

explanation.surface: Wives turning up the music and stripping off to arouse desire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volume' reads as loudness, but here it is a book.
explanation.definitionFit: Emotive language is designed to arouse strong feeling, which is stirring passion on purpose.

clue.text: Economise when restoring Sid's camper van

indicators.note: restoring the van means rebuilding it, so its letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: Cutting costs by doing up Sid's old camper van.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrimp and save is an idiom for living frugally and putting money aside.

clue.text: Overrun serving up, say, a quiet lager?

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters are read bottom to top

parts.note: eg, for example, is signalled by say
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet
Pils is a pilsner, a pale lager

explanation.surface: Are you offering me a quiet beer, so to speak, as things run late?
explanation.definitionFit: Slippage is a failure to meet a schedule, the amount by which a project runs over time.

clue.text: Tummy ache SRN treated with an infusion of hot plant

indicators.note: the nurse treats the ache by mixing it up with a dose of the hot letter, so all the letters are rearranged

parts.note: SRN is State Registered Nurse, a former British nursing grade
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on a tap

explanation.surface: A stomach ache treated by a nurse with a hot herbal tea.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange TUMMYACHESRN together with the H for hot.
explanation.definitionFit: The chrysanthemum is a flowering garden plant of the daisy family.

clue.text: Entertained by palace, Lebedev is a VIP

indicators.note: the answer is held, as a guest is entertained, within the words palace and Lebedev

explanation.surface: A wealthy newspaper owner like Lebedev hosted at a palace counts as a very important person.
explanation.walkthrough: Evgeny Lebedev is a Russian-British newspaper owner, now a peer; his name supplies most of the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A celeb, short for celebrity, is a famous person, the kind treated as a very important person.

clue.text: Geordie's 24 hour Greek diet's introduced healthy meze dish

indicators.note: the Greek assembly is brought in between the cigarette word and the hour letter

parts.note: 24-across is a cigarette, and tab is Tyneside (Geordie) slang for a cigarette
the boule was the council or legislative assembly (diet) of an ancient Greek city

explanation.surface: A Newcastle smoker's round-the-clock Greek eating plan brings in a wholesome small-plate salad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Diet' looks like an eating plan but means an assembly, as in the Diet of Worms. A Geordie is someone from Newcastle upon Tyne.
explanation.definitionFit: Tabbouleh is a Levantine salad of bulgur wheat, parsley and tomato, served among meze starters.

clue.text: Creakiest, faltering Dean?

indicators.note: something faltering is unsteady, so the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: An elderly cleric whose joints creak the most is unsteady on his feet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dean' reads as a church official, but the question mark points to Christopher Dean, who with Jayne Torvill won Olympic gold in ice dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: Christopher Dean is a famous example of a figure skater, hence the question mark marking a definition by example.

clue.text: Suggest Monsieur is welcomed into international fold

indicators.note: the Frenchman's letter is taken inside, as a guest welcomed into a home

parts.note: a ply is a fold or layer, as of paper or yarn
M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, French for Mr

explanation.surface: A Frenchman is greeted warmly into a worldwide religious flock.
explanation.definitionFit: To imply something is to hint at it indirectly, the same as to suggest it.

clue.text: Italian city upland's occasionally lacking eggs

indicators.note: every other letter is lacking, so only the occasional letter is kept

parts.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters of upland's
ova is the Latin plural for eggs

explanation.surface: A city in the Italian hills is short of eggs now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: Padova is the Italian name of Padua, a city in the Veneto region.

clue.text: Shift underworld masonic hall

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and his realm
a lodge is the meeting place of a branch of Freemasons

explanation.surface: Moving out of the infernal Freemasons' meeting place.
explanation.definitionFit: To dislodge something is to knock it out of position, to shift it.

clue.text: Drunken camaraderie CIA banned? That's rum

indicators.note: drunken suggests the letters reeling into a new order
the letters of the spy agency are barred from the mix

parts.note: the Central Intelligence Agency, the US spy service

explanation.surface: Boozy comradeship with the spy agency shut out: that is odd, says the speaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rum' reads as the adjective strange, but here it is the drink. Remove C, I, A from CAMARADERIE and rearrange the remaining MARADERE.
explanation.definitionFit: Demerara rum is a dark spirit distilled in Guyana along the Demerara river.

clue.text: Regularly send Obama cycling somewhere to get a bacon sarnie?

definitions.text: somewhere to get a bacon sarnie?

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals

parts.note: first and third letters S and N

indicators.note: cycling moves letters round from one end to the other, here the first two to the back

parts.note: Barack is the first name of Obama

explanation.surface: Sending the President off on a bike ride to fetch a bacon sandwich.
explanation.walkthrough: A sarnie is British slang for a sandwich.
explanation.definitionFit: A snack bar sells quick light meals, such as a bacon sandwich, so it is one example of such a place.

clue.text: Retired nurse Heather bandaging tail of hurt baby bird

indicators.note: the nurse and heather letters wrap around the hurt letter like a dressing
retired means drawn back, so the nurse letters run backwards

parts.note: SEN is State Enrolled Nurse, a former British nursing grade
ling is the common heather plant

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its final letter

parts.note: last letter T

explanation.surface: A retired nurse called Heather binds the injured tail of a chick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like the nurse's name but is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A nestling is a young bird not yet old enough to leave its nest.

clue.text: In a cult, going mad. Quite mad

indicators.note: letters going mad run wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A member of a sect losing their reason entirely.
explanation.definitionFit: A lunatic, as an adjective, describes someone utterly crazy, extremely foolish or insane.

clue.text: Wretched citizen leaving second university for America

indicators.note: the second and university letters depart from the citizen word
the America letter stands in for the departed pair

parts.note: a subject is a citizen of a state, especially a monarchy

explanation.surface: A miserable person quits a second college to go to the States.
explanation.definitionFit: Abject describes a state of utter misery or degradation, close to wretched.

clue.text: Bishop falls over rejecting an ace deal

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: one ace letter is thrown out
over means turned over, so the waterfall word reads backwards

parts.note: Niagara is the famous waterfall on the US-Canada border
A is the card abbreviation for ace

explanation.surface: A bishop tumbles while turning down a card in a game.
explanation.walkthrough: Reversing NIAGARA gives ARAGAIN; removing one A leaves ARGAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A bargain is an agreement or deal between parties.

clue.text: Partner of Perrins enters important meeting positively glowing

indicators.note: the partner goes into the meeting

parts.note: AGM is the annual general meeting of a company or club
Lea & Perrins is the maker of Worcestershire sauce

explanation.surface: A sauce company partner arrives at a key meeting beaming.
explanation.walkthrough: Lea & Perrins is a famous British brand of Worcestershire sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Agleam means shining brightly, gleaming, a strong form of glowing.

clue.text: Bald in Swedish (or Norwegian)

indicators.note: the answer sits in the run of letters of Swedish, or and Norwegian

explanation.surface: Asking how to say bald in Swedish, or else Norwegian.
explanation.definitionFit: Shorn means having had the hair cut off, so close-cropped or hairless like a bald head.

clue.text: Fix a few tennis games? According to Spooner it may be tipped

indicators.note: Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words, here the R and S sounds of rig and set

parts.note: to rig is to fix dishonestly, followed by a
a set is a group of tennis games, its opening S sound the same as a soft C

explanation.surface: Instructions for match-fixing a handful of tennis games.
explanation.walkthrough: RIG A SET with the opening sounds exchanged is said 'sig-a-ret'. 'Tipped' looks like a betting tip in the match-fixing scene, but means filter-tipped.
explanation.definitionFit: Many cigarettes have a filter tip, so a cigarette is a thing that may be tipped.

clue.text: Instant food popular in Asia to follow starter in Thailand

indicators.note: the grain follows the Thai initial
the starter of a word is its first letter

parts.note: first letter T
rice is the staple grain across Asia

explanation.surface: Quick food much eaten in Asia comes after a starter in Thailand.
explanation.definitionFit: A trice is a moment, as in 'in a trice', meaning in an instant.

clue.text: Food, very easy to acquire when short of time, packed with energy

indicators.note: the energy letter is stuffed inside the rest
one time letter is missing from the obtainable word

parts.note: gettable means obtainable, easy to get
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Food that is very easy to get when pressed for time, and full of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A vegetable is a plant or part of one eaten as food.

clue.text: Farewell card at the end that is in gold envelope

indicators.note: in signals the card and that-is letters go inside
the gold letters act as an envelope wrapped around the rest

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

indicators.note: only the letter at the end of card is used

parts.note: final letter D
ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A goodbye card placed at last inside a gold envelope.
explanation.definitionFit: Adieu is the French-derived word for goodbye, used in English as a formal parting.

clue.text: Southern social worker installs revolting little statue, an alarming figure

indicators.note: the care worker word has the turned statue placed inside it

parts.note: a carer looks after someone, a kind of social worker

indicators.note: revolting means turning over, so the statue word is read backwards

parts.note: a gnome is a small garden statue

explanation.surface: A southern care worker puts up a horrid garden ornament that frightens people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolting' looks like disgusting but means overturned.
explanation.definitionFit: A scaremonger spreads alarming rumours, so is a figure who causes alarm.
